organizations.csv: Key column acct_num has 13 blanks and 18 duplicates; these must be resolved before load (organization_id is required and unique).
company_name has 49 values with leading/trailing whitespace; transform will trim.
company_status contains variants (ACTIVE/active) and a misspelling (Actve). We will normalize; final handling of dormancy vs Prospect and null statuses awaits customer confirmation.
last_activity_date (5 rows) and created_on (4 rows) include future dates; we will not alter them during transform—please review for data correctness.

primary_contact_email has 39 malformed addresses and 102 with uppercase letters; we will lowercase and rely on validation to flag malformed entries. There are 30 normalized duplicates; ensure only one primary contact per organization (cross-record rule).
Country disambiguation for CA will use Rule 5 with created_on and hq_state. This assumes created_on reflects the CRM row creation date; if it does not, please advise.
industry_code includes numeric values (31, 23) whose meaning is unclear; until clarified, we will map only the known letter codes and set others to other.
last_activity_date is not stored but will be used to compute lifecycle_status per Rule 2.
Website field includes 216 URLs without scheme and 94 placeholders; we will prepend https:// and null out placeholders.
employee_count includes 147 whole numbers written with a decimal point and 121 placeholders; we will truncate decimals and null placeholders.
contacts.csv: 22 contacts have null acct_num; these will fail the required contact.organization_id reference unless backfilled or derived before load.

106 malformed emails in contact_mail will fail the required email format; 240 uppercase and 33 case-variant groups will be normalized to lowercase, which may reveal duplicates within an organization at validation.
Phone numbers need a default country for E.164; 88 too-short numbers will be invalid even after normalization.
Applying rule 13 as fallback for is_primary may produce multiple primaries within an organization; this must be resolved during validation to satisfy the 'at most one primary' cross-record rule.
full_name has extra whitespace in some rows; trimming is included in the split rule.
last_touch includes 8 future dates; if these are later used to seed activities, confirm whether future-dated events are acceptable.
Ensure the organizations dataset (or prior load) provides matching organization.organization_id values equal to acct_num so contact.organization_id references resolve.
subscriptions.json: subscription.seats, subscription.start_date and subscription.renewal_date are required by the target. Source has 4.1% null seat_count, 9 null start_dt and 16 null renew_dt; these will need remediation or exclusion at validation.
Mapping 'Legacy Gold' depends on seat_count (rule 7). Rows with 'Legacy Gold' and null seat_count cannot be deterministically mapped to a plan; flag for data cleanup or a fallback rule at validation.
Per rule 11, trial subscriptions older than 90 days should not be migrated. Engineer should filter rows where sub_status -> trial and start_date is >90 days before the migration cutover date.
Quarterly billing ('Q') will be converted to monthly (rule 9). Amounts are already monthly regardless of billing frequency (rule 12).
acct_num will populate subscription.organization_id; ensure the organizations load uses the same identifier so subscriptions can reference existing organizations (cross-record rule 1).
Validate cross-record rule: an inactive or churned organization cannot hold a trial or active subscription. This will be enforced after organization lifecycle statuses are set.
Renewal dates must be after start dates per the catalog; data contains future dates (2 start_dt, 81 renew_dt). Handle violations during validation.
activity.csv: Activities will reference activity.organization_id from acct_num; ensure corresponding organizations (organization.organization_id) are created before loading activities, per cross-record rule.
activity_type includes mixed case and two out-of-enum values (Ticket, Call). Mapping proposed for known values; customer confirmation needed for the two outliers.
occurred_at contains four formats; transformation assumes UTC when timezone is absent and normalizes to ISO 8601 UTC.
amount contains formatted numerics and placeholders; placeholders ("n/a","unknown") will become null. Many rows naturally have null amounts for non-monetary activities.
The currency column is redundant because activity amounts are stored as USD only and the only non-null value observed is USD.
